description: MiG-27 allotted by the IAF in 2020 to Kerala Tourism at the initiative of Wg Cdr N R Kanthy (retd) and AM B Suresh, both Loyola alumni; erected April 2021 on the school frontage on Air Force Road with the school bearing erection and maintenance costs. BR lists MiG-27ML TS-509 as preserved in Thiruvananthapuram at a Rajiv Gandhi-named site, which may or may not be this airframe; serial therefore left blank. Source NIE 18 Apr 2021, BR.
